2: (() => {

4:   if (!canvas) return;

11:     h: 50,
12:     x: 80,
13:     y: GROUND - 50,
14:     vy: 0,
15:     jumpV: -12,
16:     gravity: 0.6,
17:     sliding: false,
18:     slideTimer: 0,
19:     slideDuration: 15,
20:     onGround() {return this.y >= GROUND - this.h;}
21:   };
22:   const obstacles = [];
23:   const orbs = [];
24:   let frame = 0, score = 0, gameOver = false;
25: 
26:   // Input handling: click/tap toggles jump or slide
27:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => {
28:     if (gameOver) return reset();
29:     if (PLAYER.onGround()) {
30:       PLAYER.vy = PLAYER.jumpV;
31:     } else if (!PLAYER.sliding) {
32:       PLAYER.sliding = true;
33:       PLAYER.slideTimer = PLAYER.slideDuration;
34:       PLAYER.h = 30; // shorter height while sliding
35:     }
36:   });
37: 
38:   function reset() {
39:     obstacles.length = 0;
40:     orbs.length = 0;
41:     PLAYER.y = GROUND - 50;
42:     PLAYER.vy = 0;
43:     PLAYER.h = 50;
44:     PLAYER.sliding = false;
45:     frame = 0;
46:     score = 0;
47:     gameOver = false;
48:     loop();
49:   }
50: 
51:   function spawnObstacle() {
52:     const w = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
53:     const h = 30 + Math.random() * 40;
54:     obstacles.push({x: W + w, y: GROUND - h, w, h});
55:   }
56: 
57:   function spawnOrb() {
58:     const r = 8;
59:     const y = GROUND - 80 - Math.random() * 100;
60:     orbs.push({x: W + r, y, r});
61:   }
62: 
63:   function update() {
64:     frame++;
65:     // Player physics
66:     PLAYER.vy += PLAYER.gravity;
67:     PLAYER.y += PLAYER.vy;
68:     if (PLAYER.y > GROUND - PLAYER.h) {
69:       PLAYER.y = GROUND - PLAYER.h;
70:       PLAYER.vy = 0;
71:     }
72:     if (PLAYER.sliding) {
73:       PLAYER.slideTimer--;
74:       if (PLAYER.slideTimer <= 0) {
75:         PLAYER.sliding = false;
76:         PLAYER.h = 50;
77:       }
78:     }
79:     // Move obstacles & orbs
80:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= 4);
81:     orbs.forEach(o => o.x -= 4);
82:     // Remove off‑screen
83:     while (obstacles.length && obstacles[0].x + obstacles[0].w < 0) obstacles.shift();
84:     while (orbs.length && orbs[0].x + orbs[0].r < 0) orbs.shift();
85:     // Spawn logic
86:     if (frame % 120 === 0) spawnObstacle();
87:     if (frame % 200 === 0) spawnOrb();
88:     // Collision detection
89:     for (const o of obstacles) {
90:       if (PLAYER.x < o.x + o.w && PLAYER.x + PLAYER.w > o.x &&
91:           PLAYER.y < o.y + o.h && PLAYER.y + PLAYER.h > o.y) {
92:         gameOver = true;
93:       }
94:     }
95:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
96:       const o = orbs[i];
97:       const dx = (PLAYER.x + PLAYER.w/2) - o.x;
98:       const dy = (PLAYER.y + PLAYER.h/2) - o.y;
99:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < o.r + Math.min(PLAYER.w, PLAYER.h)/2) {
100:         score += 10;
101:         orbs.splice(i, 1);
102:       }
103:     }
104:     // Falling off ground (gap) – simplified as y > GROUND
105:     if (PLAYER.y > GROUND) gameOver = true;
106:     if (!gameOver) score++;
107:   }
108: 
109:   function draw() {
110:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
111:     // Ground
112:     ctx.fillStyle = '#444';
113:     ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND, W, H - GROUND);
114:     // Player silhouette
115:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
116:     ctx.fillRect(PLAYER.x, PLAYER.y, PLAYER.w, PLAYER.h);
117:     // Obstacles
118:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
119:     obstacles.forEach(o => ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h));
120:     // Orbs
121:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
122:     orbs.forEach(o => {
123:       ctx.beginPath();
124:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
125:       ctx.fill();
126:     });
127:     // Score / Game Over
128:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
129:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
130:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
131:     if (gameOver) {
132:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
133:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
134:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
135:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
136:       ctx.fillText('Game Over - Click to Restart', W/2, H/2);
137:     }
138:   }
139: 
140:   function loop() {
141:     if (!gameOver) update();
142:     draw();
143:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
144:   }
145:   // expose for debugging
146:   window.gameReset = reset;
147:   loop();
148: })();
